title.narrative: Closing Phase of the Project on Information Provision regarding the Location of Explosive Devices as an Enabler of Peacebuilding Processes in Colombia

description.narrative: Colombia has made significant progress in mine action following the 2016 Peace Agreement, yet explosive ordnance continues to impact rural communities due to ongoing territorial disputes and conflict. To strengthen the Integrated Mine Action (AICMA) policy, UNMAS, in collaboration with the OACP and former FARC-EP combatants, has facilitated explosive ordnance information sharing through a Tripartite Mechanism. This project, supported by the UN Multi-Partner Trust Fund for Peace, aims to finalize the project's closure phase by analyzing collected data to enhance national mine action policies and training. UNMAS has engaged UNOPS to deploy personnel and provide grants for information collection, updating methodologies, training, and national mine action standards to improve explosive ordnance risk mitigation efforts.
